Research & Academic Workspace

Draw academic notation in 2D and explore labeled, inspectable models in 3D. The workspace combines safe equation graphs, physics demonstrations, molecular structures, scalar fields, and editable imported geometry.

Physics, Chemistry and Math

  • Vectors, matrix transforms, inclined planes, energy/power reporting, and equal-mass elastic collision demonstrations.
  • Molecules, orbitals, PDB proteins and peptides, CUBE scalar fields, and labels for atoms, residues, chains, and mesh components.
  • Safe equation surfaces with time animation, 3D Boolean operations, editable meshes, STL/OBJ/CSV import, and CSV sample transfer to Table IDE.
